My in-house PFSS/WSA model matches CCMC's WSA 5.4 well (0.93 correlation, 50 km/s RMS, 99.8% polarity agreement at 21.5 R☉), confirming it's suitable as an independent ensemble member. While the DA queue runs, I'll start writing the empirical-trend benchmark, beginning with the observational side.

  "content": "import json
import sys
from pathlib import Path

import numpy as np
import pandas as pd
import matplotlib

matplotlib.use("Agg")
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt

sys.path.insert(0, str(Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1] / "src/py"))
import heliopy as H
import inputs as I
import run_helio as R

OUT = Path(__file__).resolve().parent / "out_empirical"
OUT.mkdir(exist_ok=True)
SC = {"earth": "omni", "stereo_a": "stereo_a", "solar_orbiter": "solar_orbiter", "mars": "maven"}


def fit(x, y):
    ok = np.isfinite(x) & np.isfinite(y) & (x > 0) & (y > 0)
    lx, ly = np.log10(x[ok]), np.log10(y[ok])
    b, a = np.polyfit(lx, ly, 1)
    return {"slope": float(b), "r": float(np.corrcoef(lx, ly)[0, 1]), "n": int(ok.sum())}


def metrics(n, v, T, r_au):
    return {"logn_vs_logv": fit(v, n), "logT_vs_logv": fit(v, T), "log_nv2_vs_logv": fit(v, n * v ** 2), "log_nv_vs_logv": fit(v, n * v),
            "median_n_r2": float(np.nanmedian(n * r_au ** 2)), "median_v": float(np.nanmedian(v)), "median_T": float(np.nanmedian(T)), "median_r_au": float(np.nanmedian(r_au))}


def observed(t0="2025-11-12", t1="2025-12-08"):
    out = {}
    for b, s in SC.items():
        o = R.insitu_hourly(s)
        o = o[(o.t >= I.tsec(t0)) & (o.t <= I.tsec(t1))].dropna(subset=["n", "v"])
        e = I.ephem(b if b != "mars" else "mars")
        r = np.interp(o.t, e.t, e.r_au)
        out[b] = metrics(o.n.to_numpy(), o.v.to_numpy(), o["T"].to_numpy(), r)
    return out


def modeled(wd, t0="2025-11-12", t1="2025-12-08"):
    pr = R.probes(wd)
    out = {}
    for b, s in SC.items():
        o = R.insitu_hourly(s)
        o = o[(o.t >= I.tsec(t0)) & (o.t <= I.tsec(t1))].dropna(subset=["n", "v"])
        m = pr[b]
        ok = np.isfinite(m.n.to_numpy())
        g = lambda k: np.interp(o.t, m.t[ok], m[k][ok])
        out[b] = metrics(g("n"), g("v"), g("T"), g("r"))
    return out


def radial(wd, t0="2025-11-20", t1="2025-12-08"):
    t, r, lam, sl = H.read_slices(Path(wd) / "slices.bin")
    sel = (t >= I.tsec(t0)) & (t <= I.tsec(t1))
    n, v, T = sl[sel, 0], sl[sel, 1], sl[sel, 2]
    nr2 = n * r[None, :, None] ** 2
    rows = []
    for k, rr in enumerate(r):
        if rr < 0.2:
            continue
        a = nr2[:, k].ravel()
        rows.append({"r": float(rr), "nr2_med": float(np.median(a)), "nr2_p90_p10": float(np.percentile(a, 90) / np.percentile(a, 10)), "nr2_max_med": float(np.percentile(a, 99.5) / np.median(a)),
                     "v_med": float(np.median(v[:, k])), "v_std": float(np.std(v[:, k])), "T_med": float(np.median(T[:, k]))})
    df = pd.DataFrame(rows)
    a = (df.r > 0.3) & (df.r < 1.0)
    b = (df.r > 1.0) & (df.r < 2.3)
    slopes = {"T_slope_0.3_1": float(np.polyfit(np.log(df.r[a]), np.log(df.T_med[a]), 1)[0]), "T_slope_1_2.3": float(np.polyfit(np.log(df.r[b]), np.log(df.T_med[b]), 1)[0]),
              "nr2_med_slope_1_2.3": float(np.polyfit(np.log(df.r[b]), np.log(df.nr2_med[b]), 1)[0]), "v_std_ratio_2_over_1": float(np.interp(2.0, df.r, df.v_std) / np.interp(1.0, df.r, df.v_std)),
              "nr2_spread_ratio_2_over_1": float(np.interp(2.0, df.r, df.nr2_p90_p10) / np.interp(1.0, df.r, df.nr2_p90_p10))}
    fig, ax = plt.subplots(1, 3, figsize=(13, 3.8))
    ax[0].loglog(df.r, df.T_med, label="model median T")
    ax[0].loglog(df.r, df.T_med.iloc[np.argmin(np.abs(df.r - 1))] * df.r ** -0.7, "k--", label="r^-0.7 (Helios slow)")
    ax[0].loglog(df.r, df.T_med.iloc[np.argmin(np.abs(df.r - 1))] * df.r ** (-4 / 3), "k:", label="r^-4/3 adiabatic")
    ax[1].plot(df.r, df.nr2_p90_p10, label="(n r^2) p90/p10")
    ax[1].plot(df.r, df.nr2_max_med, label="(n r^2) p99.5/median")
    ax[2].plot(df.r, df.v_std, label="std(v)")
    for a_ in ax:
        a_.set_xlabel("r [AU]")
        a_.legend(fontsize=7)
    fig.tight_layout()
    fig.savefig(OUT / "radial_trends.png", dpi=110)
    plt.close(fig)
    return slopes, df


if __name__ == "__main__":
    res = {"observed": observed()}
    if len(sys.argv) > 1:
        res["model"] = modeled(R.RUNS / sys.argv[1])
    if len(sys.argv) > 2:
        res["radial"], _ = radial(R.RUNS / sys.argv[2])
    (OUT / "results.json").write_text(json.dumps(res, indent=1))
    print(json.dumps(res, indent=1))

The model reproduces the n–v and T–v anticorrelation slopes well, though protons come out ~3× too cold (50–58 kK vs. 147–170 kK) since γ=5/3 lacks heating—I'll add γ=1.5 to the physics sensitivity set. Next up: the product-1 timeseries script for the ensemble.

  "content": "import json
import sys
from pathlib import Path

import numpy as np
import pandas as pd
import matplotlib

matplotlib.use("Agg")
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import matplotlib.dates as mdates

import inputs as I
import run_helio as R

ROOT = R.ROOT
PRE = Path("/mnt/c/Users/cabot/OneDrive/Documents/Research/Cambridge/X3I/analysis_repro/analysis_06_solar_wind/outputs")
F_ION = (3e-4, 1e-3)


def load_members(names):
    out = {}
    for nm in names:
        pr = R.probes(R.RUNS / nm)
        out[nm] = pr["3i_atlas"]
    return out


def ensemble(members, t_grid):
    keys = ("n", "v", "flux", "flux_rel", "v_rel")
    A = {k: np.stack([np.interp(t_grid, m.t, m[k]) for m in members.values()]) for k in keys}
    return A


def preprint_ballistic():
    d = pd.read_csv(PRE / "mapped_flux.tsv", sep="\t")
    d["utc"] = pd.Timestamp("1858-11-17") + pd.to_timedelta(d.mjd_utc, unit="D")
    return d


def plot(members, ref, out, t0="2025-11-30", t1="2025-12-07"):
    tg = np.arange(I.tsec(t0), I.tsec(t1), 1800.0)
    utc = I.T_REF + pd.to_timedelta(tg, unit="s")
    A = ensemble(members, tg)
    enl = R.ccmc_evo("3i_atlas")
    pre = preprint_ballistic()
    g = pd.read_csv(ROOT / "data/xmm/pn_gti.csv")
    fig, ax = plt.subplots(4, 1, figsize=(10, 11), sharex=True, gridspec_kw={"height_ratios": [1, 1, 1.2, 0.8]})
    spec = [("n", "proton density n$_p$ [cm$^{-3}$]", 1.0, True), ("v", "bulk speed |v| [km s$^{-1}$]", 1.0, False), ("flux", "proton flux n|v| [cm$^{-2}$ s$^{-1}$]", 1.0, True)]
    for a, (k, lab, sc, lg) in zip(ax, spec):
        X = A[k] * sc
        a.fill_between(utc, np.percentile(X, 2.5, 0), np.percentile(X, 97.5, 0), color="C0", alpha=0.15, lw=0, label="ensemble 95% range")
        a.fill_between(utc, np.percentile(X, 16, 0), np.percentile(X, 84, 0), color="C0", alpha=0.35, lw=0, label="ensemble 68% range")
        a.plot(utc, np.median(X, 0), "C0-", lw=1.4, label="ensemble median")
        if ref in members:
            a.plot(utc, np.interp(tg, members[ref].t, members[ref][k]) * sc, "k-", lw=1.0, label="reference member")
        e = enl[(enl.t >= tg[0]) & (enl.t <= tg[-1])]
        a.plot(e.utc, e[k], "r--", lw=1.0, label="CCMC ENLIL (Jan_Deca_120925_SH_1)")
        if lg:
            a.set_yscale("log")
        a.set_ylabel(lab)
    ax[1].plot(utc, np.median(A["v_rel"], 0), "C2:", lw=1.2, label="median |v - v$_{comet}$|")
    ax[2].plot(utc, np.median(A["flux_rel"], 0), "C2-", lw=1.0, label="median comet-frame flux n|v - v$_{comet}$|")
    p = pre[(pre.utc >= utc[0]) & (pre.utc <= utc[-1])]
    for c, st in (("stereo_a", "m-."), ("wind", "g-."), ("solar_orbiter", "y-.")):
        if c in p:
            ax[2].plot(p.utc, p[c], st, lw=0.9, label=f"preprint ballistic map ({c})")
    lo, hi = np.percentile(A["flux_rel"], 16, 0), np.percentile(A["flux_rel"], 84, 0)
    ax[3].fill_between(utc, F_ION[0] * lo, F_ION[1] * hi, color="C3", alpha=0.25, lw=0, label="f = 3e-4 to 1e-3 x comet-frame flux (68% range)")
    ax[3].plot(utc, 6e-4 * np.median(A["flux_rel"], 0), "C3-", lw=1.2, label="f = 6e-4, median")
    ax[3].axhspan(1.0e5 - 3.8e4, 1.0e5 + 3.8e4, color="0.5", alpha=0.2, label="preprint prior N(1.0e5, 3.8e4)")
    ax[3].set_yscale("log")
    ax[3].set_ylabel("heavy-ion flux [cm$^{-2}$ s$^{-1}$]")
    for a in ax:
        a.axvspan(pd.Timestamp(I.OBS_ALL[0]), pd.Timestamp(I.OBS_ALL[1]), color="orange", alpha=0.18, lw=0)
        for r in g.itertuples():
            a.axvspan(pd.Timestamp(r.start_utc), pd.Timestamp(r.stop_utc), ymin=0, ymax=0.04, color="orange", alpha=0.9, lw=0)
        a.grid(alpha=0.3)
    ax[0].legend(fontsize=7, loc="upper left", ncol=2)
    ax[1].legend(fontsize=7, loc="upper left", ncol=2)
    ax[2].legend(fontsize=6.5, loc="upper left", ncol=2)
    ax[3].legend(fontsize=7, loc="upper left")
    ax[3].xaxis.set_major_formatter(mdates.DateFormatter("%b %d"))
    ax[0].set_title(f"Solar wind at 3I/ATLAS (r = 1.87 AU), 3D MHD + in-situ assimilation, {len(members)}-member ensemble\nshaded: XMM-Newton pointing; ticks: accepted EPIC-pn GTIs", fontsize=10)
    fig.tight_layout()
    fig.savefig(out, dpi=150)
    fig.savefig(Path(out).with_suffix(".pdf"))
    plt.close(fig)
    stats = {}
    gt = []
    for r in g.itertuples():
        a_, b_ = I.tsec(r.start_utc), I.tsec(r.stop_utc)
        k = max(1, int(np.ceil((b_ - a_) / 300)))
        e = np.linspace(a_, b_, k + 1)
        gt.append(np.c_[(e[:-1] + e[1:]) / 2, np.diff(e)])
    gt = np.concatenate(gt)
    win = (tg >= I.tsec(I.OBS[0])) & (tg <= I.tsec(I.OBS[1]))
    for k in ("n", "v", "flux", "flux_rel"):
        gm = np.array([np.sum(np.interp(gt[:, 0], m.t, m[k]) * gt[:, 1]) / gt[:, 1].sum() for m in members.values()])
        wm = np.median(A[k][:, win], 1)
        stats[k] = {"gti_mean_median": float(np.median(gm)), "gti_mean_p16": float(np.percentile(gm, 16)), "gti_mean_p84": float(np.percentile(gm, 84)), "gti_mean_min": float(gm.min()), "gti_mean_max": float(gm.max()),
                    "window_median_median": float(np.median(wm)), "window_min_over_members": float(A[k][:, win].min()), "window_max_over_members": float(A[k][:, win].max()),
                    "dynamic_range_median": float(np.median(A[k][:, win].max(1) / A[k][:, win].min(1)))}
    stats["heavy_ion_flux_gti"] = {"f_3e-4_p16": F_ION[0] * stats["flux_rel"]["gti_mean_p16"], "f_1e-3_p84": F_ION[1] * stats["flux_rel"]["gti_mean_p84"], "f_6e-4_median": 6e-4 * stats["flux_rel"]["gti_mean_median"]}
    stats["members"] = list(members)
    Path(out).with_suffix(".json").write_text(json.dumps(stats, indent=1))
    csv = pd.DataFrame({"utc": utc.strftime("%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%S")})
    for k in ("n", "v", "flux", "flux_rel"):
        csv[f"{k}_p16"], csv[f"{k}_median"], csv[f"{k}_p84"] = np.percentile(A[k], 16, 0), np.median(A[k], 0), np.percentile(A[k], 84, 0)
    csv.to_csv(Path(out).with_suffix(".csv"), index=False, float_format="%.5g")
    return stats


if __name__ == "__main__":
    out = sys.argv[1]
    ref = sys.argv[2]
    names = sys.argv[3:]
    print(json.dumps(plot(load_members(names), ref, out), indent=1))

s=open(p).read()
s=s.replace('''def inhouse(src):
    raise NotImplementedError(src)''','''def _read_npz(path):
    z = np.load(path, allow_pickle=False)
    meta = json.loads(str(z["meta"]))
    t = pd.Timestamp(meta["map_time_utc"])
    return {"t_s": float(I.tsec(t)), "utc": str(t), "lat": z["lat_deg"].astype(float), "lon": z["lon_carr_deg"].astype(float), "br": z["br_coronal_21p5_nT"].astype(float), "v": z["v_wsa_kms"].astype(float)}


def inhouse(src, t0="2025-10-20", t1="2025-12-08"):
